- The worst paths are input-port-to-register paths, so their slack depends directly on the DEFAULT 4.0 ns input delay, not only on internal logic.

## Fixes

None required: every corner and the 10% derate gate report passed with positive slack. For reference only, if margin is ever needed on the op[*] -> _342_ cone (e.g. if the real input delay budget turns out larger than 4.0 ns), ranked by expected effect:
1. Confirm the real external I/O delay budget (G1 open question) - the cheapest and most decisive lever, since the worst paths start at input ports.
2. Upsize/buffer the high-fanout opcode decode nets that feed the result mux (requires the per-cell path report to confirm).
3. Re-place the opcode decode logic closer to the op[*] pins and the _342_ register.
4. Register the opcode at the input (would add a pipeline stage; conflicts with REQ-009 1-cycle latency, so only with a spec change).
